settings.label: Email
settings.note: I answer emails within one working day, usually the same day.

settings.label: Phone
settings.note: Better for anything urgent, though if it rings out it is because both hands are in a batch.

settings.heading: What to include
settings.body: If it is about an order, the order number saves us a round trip. If it is about your skin, tell me what it is doing and what you have tried, and I will give you a straight answer even when the straight answer is that we do not make the thing you need.

settings.heading: Returns and the Two-Week Trial
settings.body: If a product has not suited you, email and say so. You do not need to explain yourself, and you do not need to send a full bottle back. Everything you are entitled to is set out in our returns policy, including the 14-day statutory right to cancel and our extended 60-day return period.

settings.heading: Privacy
settings.body: Anything you send goes to me and nowhere else. What happens to it is in our privacy policy.

settings.heading: Contact
settings.intro: Everything here is made by hand by one person, so the person answering this email is the person who made your moisturiser. That has an obvious drawback, which is that I am sometimes in the workshop rather than at the desk. It also means nobody is going to read you a script.
settings.form_note: It goes to the same inbox. Only the email address is required.
